I built this whole website for a baker. She never asked me to.
Episode one: Rachael from Valley Girl Kitchen.
Her recipes, drops, and shop were scattered across different platforms.
So I put everything into one home that she owns.
Comment recipe, and you land right on the recipe. No app, no login.
Need a bigger batch? One tap, and every amount updates.
The whole recipe box is searchable, so her old favorites keep getting found.
And her next drop and her shop are always one tap away, so a recipe visit can turn into a sale.
Behind it all, one dashboard shows her the whole journey, from Instagram comment to order.
And all of it works just as smoothly on a phone.
If you run a small business, this is what your website could feel like.
Rachael, let me know what you think. And drop a business below that I should surprise in episode two.
